title: H-cage (built)
suptitle: R_thigh_roll_flip H-cage (owner 2026-11-19 / 11-20): roll case on its 2 lower ear screws per face, plates trimmed to z 177 above them; knee case on 2 medial + 2 lateral screws; lateral cheek trimmed to the blue thigh shell
body:
mass 16.14 g PAHT-CF + 8 steel sleeves 1.35 g (was 17.26 g; today's U: 16.0 g)
plates + end walls: top z 177 / 176 (was 186.5); above the lower ear screws only
  the shell posts (to z 176.3) and the ear-boss key pocket walls remain
screws: 6 x M2x8 (roll ears, medial knee), 2 x M2x5 (lateral knee),
  engaged 3.15-3.36 mm (ref 3.0), tips 0.64-1.50 mm short of the bottom

    knee screw heads 2.8 mm
  key pockets: boss + 0.05 mm per side (roll-torque key)
FEM (roll_flip_checks fem, PAHT-CF dry, layer normal x):

  roll stall:   p99 4.4 MPa, SR 21.0, disp 0.045 mm
  min SR over 3 materials 9.6; peak 43 MPa (lateral cheek corner)
